title: Bechtel Park courts renewal
description:
Bechtel Park courts renewal
We're planning upgrades to the courts at Bechtel Park!
After learning from residents on their preferred court options, the renewed courts will feature three tennis courts and four pickleball courts. There will also be a new fence, gate and nets.
This is a change from the existing layout, which is four hard-surface courts, used for both tennis and pickleball.
Project updates
